# IRoundsVaultOutputEvents
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/rounds-vault/IRoundsVaultOutputEvents.sol)

**Title:**
IRoundsVaultOutputEvents

**Author:**
Roberto Cano <robercano>

Events specific to the Output flavor of `RoundsVaultBase`.


## Events
### SharesRedeemed
Emitted by `RoundsVaultOutput._operate` when the keeper settles a round and the frozen
target-vault shares are redeemed from the target vault for its underlying asset.


```solidity
event SharesRedeemed(uint256 indexed roundId, address indexed account, uint256 shares, uint256 assets);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`roundId`|`uint256`|The id of the round being settled|
|`account`|`address`|The address that triggered the settlement (the keeper for normal flows)|
|`shares`|`uint256`|The amount of target-vault shares that were redeemed|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The amount of underlying asset received from the target vault|
